ipeds.title: IPEDS Admissions survey, fall 2024 entering class (ADM2024) via College Navigator

ipeds_portal.title: IPEDS admissions counts and fall 2024 enrollment (nonresident undergraduates) via Urban Institute Education Data Portal

stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2024 entering class): applicants, admits and enrollees from the Education Data Portal; test submission rates and percentiles from College Navigator. No public Common Data Set was found (NYIT's planning pages list a fact sheet only), so GPA, residency splits and international applicant counts are not available. SAT/ACT percentiles cover the 22% (198) / 2% (15) of enrollees who submitted scores. Undergraduate enrollment and the nonresident count (290, about 8%) are IPEDS fall 2024 undergraduate headcounts. NYIT's test-optional page gives a mid-range of 1050-1270 for admitted students who submit SAT scores.
